needsReview.note: Reads the legacy orders collection only: a pharmacy order (pharmacy_orders) always 404s. The app's deep link orders/:id/tracking and any other client of it need the pharmacy order instead.

GET /patient/pharmacy/orders/:id has no pharmacy name (allocations hold only pharmacy_account_id; the offers list drops expired offers), so the board's pharmacy row cannot be drawn.

The legacy reorder and reorder-partial refuse pharmacy orders (503 canonical_pharmacy_flow_required); the web reorders through the cart. The BFF route app/api/orders/[orderId]/reorder is now unused by any screen.
Order items carry no rx flag and no price. Lines are marked as needing a prescription when the order has a prescription_id, so checkout asks again; a line-level flag would be exact.
